prompt: In dominoes, you can play a tile if one of its ends matches one of the open ends on the table. The open ends show 6 and 3. Which of these tiles can you play?
explanation: Only the 6-2 tile has an end matching an open end: its 6 matches the open 6. The other tiles have no 6 and no 3 on either end.
